# Pilot 1b tables (post hoc; generated by `project_anomaly/scripts/analyze_pilot1b.py`)

P(satisfied reading) by signed distance from the cutoff; 30 base cases per cell. Ideal reader: 0 at and below the cutoff, 1 above it. Thresholds: `rel±r` = r × cutoff (rounded to the unit, ≥ 1 unit), `unit±1` = one unit (1 year / 1 credit / €5,000). Resolution = nearest distance from which P_sat stays ≤ 0.1 (below) or ≥ 0.9 (above) at all farther distances.
